full_prompt_en: The image is a square architectural illustration of a compact cluster of slender towers and blocklike buildings, set against a muted gray-blue sky. The skyline rises from a straight ochre ground strip along the bottom, with no surrounding landscape or street scene. At the far left, a low pale blue tower carries an open square lantern above its small, closely spaced windows. Just right of it, a taller warm yellow tower has narrow dark window openings and another open pavilion at its top. Near the center, a slim gold clock tower stands in front of the cluster; two round white clock faces punctuate its upper section, and a small roofed cap sits above them. Behind this tower, a taller cream and ochre block reaches highest, its stacked small windows arranged in strict rows beneath a shallow roof. To the right, a blue rectangular mass has a flat face broken by dark windows, while a pale cylindrical tower with a dark roof rises behind it. Several shorter burnt-orange and yellow buildings fill the lower middle, their walls pressed closely together and their different roof heights forming small steps. Along the lower edge, a few white and pale blue facades open into dark arches and narrow doorways, establishing a simple base for the dense vertical forms. The surfaces appear softly textured, with slightly grainy color rather than smooth photographic detail. Fine dark outlines and tiny window marks define the volumes, but the larger ochre, brick-red, powder-blue, and cream color areas remain dominant. Light falls evenly from above and slightly left, leaving modest darker sides and recesses instead of deep cast shadows. The frontal viewpoint keeps most walls parallel to the picture plane, making the overlapping towers read as an ordered collage of simple geometric masses. The overall composition balances a quiet, spacious sky against a tightly packed city silhouette whose warm and cool blocks create a measured vertical rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形建筑插画，描绘一组紧密聚集的细高塔楼与方块建筑，背景是低饱和的灰蓝天空。天际线从画面底边一条平直的赭色地面带升起，周围没有其他风景或街道场景。最左侧一座较矮的浅蓝塔楼在排列紧密的小窗上方顶着开放式方形亭阁。其右侧较高的暖黄色塔楼有狭窄的深色窗洞，顶端也有一座开放的小亭。靠近中央，一座纤细的金黄色钟楼立在建筑群前，两面圆形白色钟面点在上段，上方还有一顶小屋盖。钟楼背后，更高的奶油色与赭色建筑升到最高处，成排小窗堆叠在浅屋顶下。右侧一块蓝色长方体立面被深色窗洞打断，后方则升起一座带暗色屋顶的浅色圆塔。较矮的焦橙色和黄色建筑填满中下部，墙面彼此挤紧，不同屋顶高度形成细小台阶。沿底边，几块白色和浅蓝色立面开着深色拱门与窄门洞，为密集的竖向形体提供简洁基座。表面带轻微颗粒色感，而非光滑的摄影细节。细暗色轮廓线与小窗标记确定体量，但赭色、砖红、粉蓝和奶油色的大块色域仍占主导。光线从上方略偏左均匀照下，只让侧面与凹处稍暗，没有深重的投影。正面视点使多数墙面与画面平行，让相互遮挡的塔楼像有序的简单几何块拼贴。整体构图以安静宽敞的天空对照紧密的城市剪影，冷暖色块组成有节制的竖向节奏。
style_prompt_en: The image has an architectural illustration finish built from frontal, simplified geometric volumes. Tall narrow blocks overlap in a dense central grouping, while a broad, nearly unbroken cool field gives their silhouette room to breathe. Muted ochre, brick red, pale cream, and powder blue occupy separate matte areas, with small dark openings supplying crisp accents. Edges are mostly straight and well defined, yet the color has a faint granular softness that keeps the construction from looking mechanically flat. Shallow side shading and dark recesses suggest volume without a dramatic cast-shadow system. Repeated small marks and stepped heights make the dense group legible as a measured vertical rhythm. The overall effect is orderly, quiet, and lightly textured, with color areas carrying more weight than surface detail.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有建筑插画的完成面，由正面呈现、简化的几何体量构成。细长色块在中央密集交叠，而大片几乎不被打断的冷色背景为其剪影留出呼吸空间。低饱和的赭黄、砖红、浅奶油色和粉蓝色分占不同的哑光区域，小块深色开口形成清脆的强调。边缘大多平直明确，色层却带细微颗粒柔度，避免构造显得机械而扁平。浅淡的侧面明暗和深色内凹处暗示体积，没有戏剧化的投影体系。重复的小记号和阶梯式高低差使密集组合形成有节制的竖向节奏。整体效果有序、安静、带轻微纹理，色彩面积比表面细节更有分量。
theme_en: A compact town of slender colored towers against a gray-blue sky
theme_zh: 灰蓝天空前由彩色细塔组成的紧凑城镇
name: Aldo Rossi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
